description.narrative:
Tranche 2 is aligned with the facility's impact: local, national, and international connectivity improved. It will have the following outcome: transport efficiency and capacity along the Manila-Clark corridor improved.
The project will deliver two outputs. Tranche 2 will finance the following outputs:
(i)Output 1: New railway line commissioned. Tranche 2 will finance the remaining part of the expenditures for the construction of an elevated double-track railway lines totaling 53.1 km, including the 51.2 km Malolos-Clark-CIA section (Malolos-Clark section), and the 1.9 km Solis-Blumentritt section (Blumentritt extension) linking the project to the existing rail-based public urban transport system in Manila. The Tranche 2 financing includes (a) construction of a depot near CIA for the maintenance of rolling stock and fixed assets, with a training center for railway staff and an operation control center; and (b) seven stations integrating design features that are accessible and safe for the elderly, women, children, and people with disabilities.
(ii)Output 2. Institutional capacity strengthened. The tranche will finance the component for the strengthening of DOTr's institutional capacity. The component will (a) start the training program for DOTr staff, of whom 50% are women, in procurement, project and contract management, railway operation, and asset management; (b) establish a system to manage the document and funding flow among all parties involved in project implementation, including technical staff; and (c) fulfill the government's gender and development mandates to ensure the provision of quality railway services to women and marginalized people.
Efficiency and capacity of transport along the Manila-Clark corridor improved

144,000 passengers transported by rail between Manila and Clark daily Progress/Status: Output 1:
As of December 2025, all 6 civil works contract packages financed under the project are under implementation.
The two contract packages (CP-N-04 and CP-N-05) for construction of the main line and depot in Clark were signed on 1 August 2020. CP N-04 contractor commenced civil works on 30 October 2020 while CP N-05 contractor commenced civil works on 28 October 2020.
The three contract packages (CP-N-01 to CP-N-03) for construction of the main line between Malolos and Clark were signed on 8 October 2020. Contractors commenced civil works on 7 December 2020.
The last contract package (CP S-01) for construction of the main line and station in Bluementritt was signed on 13 July 2023. Instruction to commence was issued on 10 November 2023 effective 14 November 2023.
Current progress of the civil works of each package achieved at the end of December 2025 (based on the latest progress report [December 2025], submitted to ADB on 12 January 2026 by the Engineer) is 70.23% for CP N-01, 51.10% (CP N-02), 40.75% (CP N-03), 72.52% (CP N-04), 96.66% (CP N-05), and 7.44% (CP S-01). The total physical progress is at 56.45%.
Output 2:
On 8 May 2025, DOTr informed ADB at a meeting that is currently finalizing the detailed Output 2 activities of both SCRP and MCRP, to optimally suite the changing circumstances of these two projects including the partial operation target for MCRP by 2028, ongoing preparation of an operation and maintenance contract for the railway projects in Metro Manila, and the changes in DOTr leadership and organization. ADB and DOTr agreed that it will finalize and agree on a detailed program for activities for the delivery of Output 2 by the end of 2025.
Since 4Q 2025, ADB and DOTr have been discussing and working on the draft terms of reference for three proposed contract packages under Output 2. Data Source: Malolos-Clark Railway's passenger records Actual value:
